test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, number, symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) $ Q 8 J & L N 9 % * K T # 6 2 V 4 @ 5 Z 7 (Right)

How many such symbols are there which are immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number?
solution: Given series: $ Q 8 J & L N 9 % * K T # 6 2 V 4 @ 5 Z 7 Condition to be checked: Symbols which are immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number. Required Pattern: **Number** → **Symbol** → **Number** $ Q 8 J & L N 9 % * K T # 6 2 V **__4 @ 5__** Z 7
